Name: Dragonkind
Lore: Elders of the sky-hoards; they remember every war and forgive none of them.

Name: ArcaneOrders
Lore: Colleges, covens and familiars. Time bends around a wizard who has outlived their own school.

Name: OrderOfTheBlade
Lore: Knightly houses bound by sworn oaths; the oath outlives the knight and keeps their banners moving.

Name: Ironhold
Lore: Dwarven holds and their forge-titans. Slow, immovable, offended.

Name: FeyCourt
Lore: The Gentry: beautiful, contractual, and always counting the favours you owe.

Name: UndyingLegion
Lore: Liches, wights and bone-choirs. Nobody out-ages a corpse that stopped keeping score.

Name: AbyssalHorde
Lore: Contract demons and their beasts. Every one of them is late for something awful.

Name: CelestialHost
Lore: Seraphs, colossi and elementals of the upper spheres - tall orders, tall statues.

Name: Beastwild
Lore: Orcs, goblins, werewolves and everything the frontier names with a shout.

Name: DeepwaterCourt
Lore: Leviathans, merrow and drowned kings. The pressure down there keeps things young and very, very old.
